items.html: Afterward ZON grew more through the aforementioned Yenika, and then rose and clothed the NHY of the third Tvuna in the aspect of her external vessels, as is known, which are of the aspect of the Katnut of Yenika. Then they nursed from there, from the three middles of Tvuna, where the chest is, the place of the breasts of the woman; and they are not in the secret of the breasts of an animal, as was at first, after their birth, when they nursed from the two lower joints of Atik that remained in Beria.
